question: Should OpenClaw expose this `referenceContext` and `reference-context` lane as public plugin SDK surface now, make it explicitly experimental, or keep only a narrower internal Codex projection until the cross-host contract is designed?
rationale: The code path is technically plausible, but it changes public plugin SDK and prompt-authority semantics that require maintainer product and security intent rather than automated cleanup judgment.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR for now, keep the canonical issue open, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor experimental SDK lane
options.body: Ask for explicit experimental wording, docs, and compatibility expectations before merging this API surface.

options.title: Sponsor stable SDK lane
options.body: Accept that third-party context engines may depend on this stable lane after merge and proceed with final maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR for now, keep the canonical issue open, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR once the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the public context-engine contract and prompt-authority model, where the history points most strongly to jalehman.
